subject: cheapaioutput-persistent-concise-mode
positive_triggers: The user explicitly invokes `cheapaioutput` or asks to turn the persistent concise chat mode on.
The user explicitly asks to turn off the active concise-output mode.
negative_triggers: The user asks for one concise answer without asking to activate a persistent mode.
The user requests detail that must remain complete for the task.
The user asks to compose a commit message.
The user asks to draft or revise content in a local file.

behavioral_evaluation.prompt: Turn on cheapaioutput. Then answer a chat question and draft content for a local technical document. Finally turn the mode off. Preserve exact flags and warnings, do not omit required detail, and use the appropriate writing skill for the local document. In a separate commit-message request, choose the correct skill.
pass_criteria: Activates only on an explicit invocation or on request and keeps the mode active until an explicit off request.
Acknowledges activation and deactivation briefly and accurately.
Removes filler and repetition while preserving meaning, grammar, important details, negations, numbers, units, and uncertainty.
Preserves exact commands, flags, paths, identifiers, and warnings when reproducing them.
Keeps requested detailed artifacts complete and compresses only unnecessary wording around them.

Applies concise wording only to chat replies, not commit messages or local file content; uses write-document for commit messages and local prose/documents and an appropriate implementation skill for code/configuration.
Preserves questions, approvals, safety information, and verification limits; does not claim guaranteed token savings or host-level persistence.
